units.note: All coordinates in pyxl units. 1 pyxl = 10px render. Backbone-local origin = ribpoint (bottom-center of rib cage / xiphoid).

ribpoint.note: Bottom-center of rib cage. Xiphoid / solar plexus. Backbone origin. Attaches to torsobone navelpoint above.

navelpoint.note: Anatomical navel. 0.25H / 8.25 pyxl below ribpoint. Midpoint of backbone.

hippoint.note: Top of hip / sacral connection. Backbone-to-hip attachment. 0.5H / 16.5 pyxl below ribpoint.

shapes.note: Lumbar spine. Rib cage base → top of hip. 0.5H / 16.5 pyxl.
Anatomical navel marker. Midpoint of backbone.

torso.note: ribpoint attaches to torsobone navelpoint (which is anatomically the rib cage base / xiphoid). Coincident.

hip.note: hippoint attaches to hipbone sacralpoint at center of ∞.

ribpoint.note: Rib cage junction. Top of backbone.

hippoint.note: Sacral / hip attachment. Bottom of backbone.

meta.derived_from: Pyxl.Papyr proportional rules — backbone = 0.5H, navel at 0.25H midpoint
meta.changelog: v1: Initial backbone. Rib (xiphoid) → hip = 0.5H / 16.5 pyxl. Navel at 0.25H / 8.25 pyxl midpoint.
